advancements.ancientcreature.progression: Complete an ancient creature's genome cartridge
Obtain a chisel for extracting delicate fossils
Craft an Incubator for your ancient egg
Extract a DNA sample from an identified fossil
Obtain a fossil fragment or an egg fossil
Incubate a baby ancient creature and bring it back from extinction
Unearth the past and bring ancient creatures back to life
guide.ancientcreature.automation.1: Every machine works with hoppers and pipes. Each side of a machine feeds a different slot. Every machine except the Fossil Cleaning Table is two blocks tall, so leave a free block above it.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.cleanin: Top: brush. Sides: dirty fossil. Bottom: clean fossil and dirt fragments.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.dna: Top: Sample Vial. North/south: Extraction Fluid. East/west: fossil. Bottom: DNA sample.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.embryog: Top: Artificial Egg. North/south: Nutrient Solution. East/west: completed cartridge. Bottom: fertilized egg.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.genome: Top: cartridge. Sides: DNA sample. Bottom: cartridge.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.identif: Top and sides: fossil. Bottom: result.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.incubat: Top and sides: fertilized egg. Bottom: capsule.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.tip: Chain machines with hoppers: each machine's bottom output can feed the next machine's input side.
guide.ancientcreature.automation.title: Automation
guide.ancientcreature.chisels.1: Chisels mine Fossil Ore and rock piles. Each one chips away part of the completeness of every fossil it digs up, so a better chisel means better fossils.
guide.ancientcreature.chisels.2: Chisels can be repaired in an anvil with their material. A chisel with Fortune adds 10%% completeness per level before the chisel's damage is taken off.
guide.ancientcreature.chisels.netherite: The Netherite Chisel does no damage at all. Upgrade a Diamond Chisel at a Smithing Table.
guide.ancientcreature.chisels.title: Chisels
guide.ancientcreature.cleaning.1: A fossil fresh out of the ground is caked in dirt. The Fossil Cleaning Table brushes it clean.
guide.ancientcreature.cleaning.2: Put a brush in the top slot and a dirty fossil in the fossil slot.
guide.ancientcreature.cleaning.3: Cleaning keeps the species, part and completeness exactly as they were. It never damages a fossil.
guide.ancientcreature.cleaning.4: Each fossil costs the brush 1 durability and drops 0-2 Dirt Fragments. Four Dirt Fragments craft back into dirt.
guide.ancientcreature.cleaning.title: Cleaning
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.1: Every species has its own size, strength, diet and temperament. Creatures you release from a capsule or hatch from a bred egg belong to you.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.breeding: Feed two adults of the same species their diet items to breed them. They lay an egg on the spot, which hatches after the species' incubation time into a baby owned by the nearest player within 10 blocks. Creatures with no diet can't be bred.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.hunger.1: Every creature has a hunger meter that slowly drains. Predators only go hunting once they are hungry and stop once they have eaten, so a well-fed predator won't chase everything in sight.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.hunger.2: Hand-feed a creature one of its diet items to fill its hunger. Hungry or not, creatures always defend themselves when attacked.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.riding.1: The owner can ride an adult creature with an empty hand or a non-food item: right-click it. No saddle is needed. Babies can't be ridden, and only one rider fits at a time.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.riding.2: Steer with the movement keys and the mouse. Flying and swimming creatures follow where you look: look up to climb and down to dive. Jump gains extra height while flying, and sneak dismounts.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.riding.3: Right-clicking with food feeds or breeds the creature instead, and sneak-right-click never mounts.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.tip: Wild creatures and your own behave the same otherwise, so keep predators away from your farm animals.
guide.ancientcreature.creatures.title: Your Creatures
guide.ancientcreature.dna.1: An identified fossil still holds only scraps of DNA. The DNA Extractor pulls them into a sample. It needs Extraction Fluid, an empty Sample Vial and an identified, clean fossil.
guide.ancientcreature.dna.2: Extraction Fluid lasts for 4 extractions. The fossil is always used up.
guide.ancientcreature.dna.quality.1: A sample's integrity comes from its score: the fossil's completeness plus the fossil part's DNA bonus. Better integrity adds more to a genome.
guide.ancientcreature.dna.quality.2: Below a score of 5%% the extraction fails: the fossil and a use of fluid are spent, but the vial is kept.
guide.ancientcreature.dna.title: DNA Extraction
guide.ancientcreature.embryogenesis.1: The Embryogenesis Chamber combines a completed genome with an Artificial Egg and Nutrient Solution to make a fertilized egg of that species.
guide.ancientcreature.embryogenesis.2: All three inputs are used up, including the cartridge.
guide.ancientcreature.embryogenesis.3: Egg Shell Fragments come from brushing suspicious sand and gravel at dig sites. Nutrient Solution uses Water Bottles and bone meal, and one craft makes 4.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.1: Every fossil belongs to a species, and the species is decided by the biome where the fossil drops. The same find in a snowy plains and in a warm ocean will be different animals. If no species lives in that biome, nothing drops.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.2: Fresh fossils are always dirty and unidentified. Their tooltip shows ??? for the species until they are identified.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.dig_site.1: Dig sites are small excavations with suspicious sand or gravel. Brush the suspicious blocks with a brush. Brushing never damages a fossil, but only turns up claws, teeth, ribs and limbs. Dig sites are the only natural source of Egg Shell Fragments, needed for Artificial Eggs.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.ore.1: Single blocks of Fossil Ore generate in stone in every Overworld biome, between Y -64 and Y 50. Mine one with a chisel to get a dirty fossil of any part, including egg fossils. A pickaxe won't drop anything.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.parts.1: Parts differ in how much of the animal survived (completeness), how likely they are to fail a first identification, and how much they help when extracting DNA.
Small piles of stone sit on the surface of Overworld biomes. Most are plain rocks, but some have bones or an egg poking out, so you can tell what's inside before breaking them.
Break them with a chisel: plain piles give Rock Fragments, piles with bones add a dirty fossil, and piles with an egg add a dirty Egg Fossil.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.tip: Egg fossils and teeth keep the most completeness. Claws keep the least.
guide.ancientcreature.fossils.title: Finding Fossils
guide.ancientcreature.genome.1: The Genome Sequencer writes DNA onto a Genome Cartridge. Each sample adds a random share of genome depending on its integrity.
guide.ancientcreature.genome.2: A blank cartridge takes the species of the first sample and becomes a filled cartridge.
guide.ancientcreature.genome.3: Keep feeding samples of the same species. With a sample of another species in the slot, the sequencer just waits. At 100%% the cartridge is completed.
guide.ancientcreature.genome.4: The cartridge stays in its slot between samples, so a hopper feeding DNA can fill it hands-free.
guide.ancientcreature.genome.tip: Each creature needs its own completed cartridge, and the cartridge is used up when the embryo is made.
guide.ancientcreature.genome.title: Genome Sequencing
guide.ancientcreature.identification.1: Put a clean fossil into the Fossil Identification Chamber. It scans the fossil and reveals its species, which shows in the tooltip from then on.
guide.ancientcreature.identification.fir: The first time a species is identified on a world is the hard one. Until then every scan of that species can fail, with a chance that depends on the fossil part (see Finding Fossils). A failed fossil stays unidentified and loses some completeness, but can be put back in to try again.
Once anyone succeeds, the species is known for everyone. Known species always identify, four times as fast, and unlock their page in the Species Journal.
guide.ancientcreature.identification.tip: Use a tooth or a skull to unlock a new species. Once it is known, even claws identify every time.
guide.ancientcreature.incubation.1: The Incubator keeps a fertilized egg warm until it is ready to hatch.
guide.ancientcreature.incubation.2: How long it takes depends on the species: bigger creatures take longer. The Species Journal lists each species' incubation time.
guide.ancientcreature.incubation.release: Use the Baby Creature Capsule on a block to release a baby of its species. You become its owner. It grows into an adult over time, and once grown you can ride it.
Capsules can't be used on Peaceful difficulty.
guide.ancientcreature.incubation.title: Incubation
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.1: This guide follows the road from a buried bone to a living creature. Each chapter covers one step. Pick a chapter on the left and scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Hover over any item to see its name.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.journ: Press [%s] to open the Species Journal. It lists every species identified on this world, with its habitat, diet, size, strength, incubation time and how long it takes to grow up.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step1: 1. Make a chisel. Fossils only drop when mined with one.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step2: 2. Find a fossil in Fossil Ore underground, or in rock piles on the surface.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step3: 3. Clean it in a Fossil Cleaning Table with a brush.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step4: 4. Identify it in a Fossil Identification Chamber to learn its species.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step5: 5. Extract its DNA in a DNA Extractor.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step6: 6. Sequence DNA of one species onto a Genome Cartridge until it reaches 100%%.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step7: 7. Grow an embryo in the Embryogenesis Chamber.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.step8: 8. Incubate the egg, then use the Baby Creature Capsule on the ground to release your creature.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.tip: Better fossils make better DNA, and better DNA fills a genome in fewer samples. Teeth, skulls and egg fossils are the best finds.
guide.ancientcreature.introduction.title: Introduction
jei.ancientcreature.dirt_output: Also yields 0-2 dirt fragments; costs 1 brush durability
jei.ancientcreature.egg_limb_bonus: Egg fossils use the limb bonus (0 points)
jei.ancientcreature.extraction_consumpti: Consumes fossil + vial; costs 1 fluid durability
jei.ancientcreature.fortune_bonus: Fortune adds 10% completeness before chisel damage
jei.ancientcreature.identification_damag: On failure, completeness is reduced by %s%%
jei.ancientcreature.identification_time: 400 ticks for a new species; 100 known species
jei.ancientcreature.method.brushing: Method: Brush suspicious blocks at dig sites
jei.ancientcreature.method.rock_pile: Method: Break a rock pile that has egg
jei.ancientcreature.rock_pile_egg_condit: Only rock piles visibly containing an egg yield this
jei.ancientcreature.rock_pile_fossil_con: Only rock piles visibly containing a fossil yield this
jei.ancientcreature.same_species: DNA Sample must have same species as filled cartridge
